build_mets_gbs_backend: build a METS GBS document backend that parses gzipped tar archives containing Google Books XML metadata and OCR data
create_mets_gbs_page_backend: create a METS GBS page backend that retrieves text cells, bitmap rects, and page images from a segmented PDF page
load_mets_gbs_document: load a METS GBS document from a gzipped tar file and extract page map with image and OCR file references
parse_mets_gbs_page: parse a single page from a METS GBS archive by extracting image and OCR XML to build segmented page with text cells
test_mets_gbs_validation: test METS GBS document backend validation by checking root METS element has PROFILE attribute set to gbs
